title: Gay Witch Hunt
one_paragraph_synopsis: In 'Gay Witch Hunt,' the office grapples with issues of sexuality and stereotypes as Oscar publicly comes out as gay, leading to humorous and awkward moments, conflicts, and attempts at support from Michael. The episode explores office dynamics and perceptions surrounding sexual orientation.

main_threads.thread: Oscar's coming out and office reactions

evidence.snippet: Oscar: No, I'm not gay. And I don't understand why anyone would think, that I'm gay… if… Uh… yeah I'm gay.
Oscar: Yes I'm gay. And I didn't plan on sharing that part of my life with you today, so, whatever.
Oscar: Yes, I'm gay.
Michael: No! That is the fun of this place. I call everybody "faggie".
Michael: That's what faggie means!
Michael: We're all homos! Homosapiens. Gays aren't necessarily who you think they are, people.
Michael: Did you know that gay used to mean happy? When I was growing up it meant lame. And now it means a man, who makes love… to other men.
Michael: We are not in the playground anymore. There are new rules. We have to be mature.

character_highlights.what_changes: Oscar publicly admits he is gay.
